# A grid has no one-call answer to which records are selected

## Context

On pull request https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/21044 (the runnable timeline example, an outside contribution) the question "which record is selected in this grid?" was answered wrong twice. The author's first read was `grid.selectionModel?.selectedRecordIds`, a name that exists nowhere. The read I then prescribed in review, `grid.view.selectionModel?.selectedRows?.[0]`, was compared with a record's key and never matched. Both failed silently behind a fallback, and each cost a review round.

## The Problem

A grid offers three pieces, and code that needs the selected record at the time of an action (a toolbar button's handler) has to know all three:

- `Neo.grid.View#selectedRows` and `Neo.selection.grid.BaseModel#selectedRows` hold ids. Their JSDoc says "The record ids". In the grid's own vocabulary that is the value of `getRecordId(record)`: the store's internal id while `useInternalId` is `true`, which is the default. An application reads "record ids" as the model's key.
- `Neo.selection.grid.BaseModel#getRowRecord(id)` resolves either kind of id to its record.
- The model's `selectionChange` event carries `records`, for code that reacts to a change.

Measured inside the app worker at `f94ce61fd3` on 2026-11-16, after a click on the third row of a store keyed `r-1` to `r-7`: `grid.view.selectionModel.selectedRows` is `["neo-record-3"]`, `getRowRecord("neo-record-3").id` is `"r-3"`, and `grid.selectionModel` is `undefined`. The probe and its numbers are in https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/21044#pullrequestreview-5915435290.

`learn/guides/datahandling/Grids.md` names none of the three in its "Selection Models" section.

## The Architectural Reality

- The View owns the selection model since #18626. `src/grid/View.mjs:334-353` holds the readers `rowSelectionModel`, `selectedCells` and `selectedRows`.
- `Design authority:` "The record ids the View's model holds selected — `[]` under a cell or column model, and under none." (`src/grid/View.mjs:348`, the JSDoc of `selectedRows`). The ids stay as they are. This ticket adds the record-valued sibling and makes two doc lines say which ids they are.
- `src/grid/Body.mjs:1250`: `getRecordId(record)` returns `store.getInternalId(record)` or `store.getKey(record)`, decided by `useInternalId` (`src/grid/Container.mjs:241`, default `true`).
- `src/selection/grid/BaseModel.mjs:428`: `getRowRecord(id)`.
- One engine consumer does the two steps by hand: `src/grid/plugin/CellEditing.mjs:216-225` reads `[rowId] = view.selectedRows` and then `view.rowSelectionModel.getRowRecord(rowId)`.

## The Fix

1. `Neo.grid.View` gets a getter `selectedRecords` beside `selectedRows`: the records of the rows the View's model holds selected, each resolved through the model's `getRowRecord`.
2. The JSDoc of `View#selectedRows` and of `BaseModel#selectedRows_` say which ids these are (the grid's row ids: internal ids while `useInternalId` is `true`, record keys otherwise) and point to `selectedRecords`.
3. `CellEditing#editSelectedCell` reads the row's record through the getter. That is the line this addition removes.
4. `examples/timeline/basic/Viewport.mjs` reads the selected resource through the getter.
5. The guide's "Selection Models" section gets one short paragraph on reading a selection.

## Contract Ledger

| Target Surface | Source of Authority | Proposed Behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Neo.grid.View#selectedRecords` (new getter) | this ticket; its siblings at `src/grid/View.mjs:334-353` | Returns `Neo.data.Record[]`: one record per id in `selectedRows`, in that order, each resolved by `rowSelectionModel.getRowRecord(id)`. A new array on every read. No event, no config, not reactive. | `[]` under a cell or column model and under none, as `selectedRows`. An id that resolves to no record is left out, so the array can be shorter than `selectedRows`. | JSDoc with `@summary`; the guide paragraph | unit spec |
| `Neo.grid.View#selectedRows` (JSDoc only) | `src/grid/View.mjs:348` | value unchanged | n/a | names the id kind and `selectedRecords` | the diff |
| `Neo.selection.grid.BaseModel#selectedRows_` (JSDoc only) | `src/selection/grid/BaseModel.mjs:33` | value unchanged | n/a | names the id kind | the diff |

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `grid.view.selectedRecords` returns the selected rows' records under `RowModel`, with `useInternalId: true` and with `useInternalId: false`. A unit spec covers both, and the three empty cases: a cell model, a column model, `selectionModel: null`. `test/playwright/unit/grid/ViewOwnedSelectionModel.spec.mjs` is the sibling to extend or to copy from; run it with `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/grid/ViewOwnedSelectionModel.spec.mjs`.
- [ ] The spec covers an id that resolves to no record: it is left out, and the other records keep their order.
- [ ] The two JSDoc lines name the id kind. Neither says "record ids" without it.
- [ ] `CellEditing#editSelectedCell` holds no `getRowRecord` call, and `test/playwright/e2e/grid/CellEditingPooling.spec.mjs` passes with no edit to its assertions.
- [ ] `examples/timeline/basic/Viewport.mjs` reads `grid.view.selectedRecords[0]`. The file arrives with pull request 21044; if that pull request is still open when this is picked up, leave this box unchecked and say so in the pull request.
- [ ] `learn/guides/datahandling/Grids.md`, section "Selection Models", says in one short paragraph how to read a selection: `grid.view.selectedRecords` at the time of an action, the model's `selectionChange` event to react to a change.

## Out of Scope

- A `selectionModel` shortcut on `Neo.grid.Container`. #18626 rejected a proxy config there ("Two stored truths for one instance; the View is the owner"), and `grid.view.selectedRecords` is one hop.
- The value of `selectedRows`, the `selectionChange` payload, and cell or column selections.
- The table family (`Neo.table.Body` keeps its own `selectedRows`).

## Avoided Traps

- **Changing `selectedRows` to hold record keys.** The paint and cell editing read these ids (`src/grid/Row.mjs:486`, `src/grid/plugin/CellEditing.mjs:216`).
- **A method on the selection model only.** The View already answers "what is selected" for rows and cells without the caller knowing which model is active. The record-valued answer belongs beside those two.
- **Rewriting `fireRowSelectionChange` onto the getter.** Its `records` are aligned by index with `selection`; the getter leaves unresolvable ids out.

## Related

- https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/21044 and its ticket #21039: where the two reads failed.
- #18626: the View owns the selection model.
- `neomjs/neo-agent-institution` `apps/agentos/view/fleet/mailbox/Container.mjs:793` reads `rowsGrid.view.rowSelectionModel` for the same purpose; it can adopt the getter after the next engine pin, outside this ticket.
